literal: On jiyou day, sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On jiyou day he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On xinhai day, shot willow to pray for rain.
idiomatic: On xinhai day he performed the willow-shooting rite to pray for rain.

literal: He went to Pinbi Marsh to escape the summer heat.
idiomatic: He went to Pinbi Marsh for his summer quarters.

literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu day, sacrificed to the divine aunt.
idiomatic: On bingxu day in the fifth month he sacrificed to the divine aunt.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju in rebellion; commissary Yelü Helibi was dispatched to suppress him.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju and rebelled; commissary Yelü Helibi was sent to suppress him.

literal: In the ninth month, Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River; his brother Anbo was sent in pursuit.
idiomatic: In the ninth month Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River and his brother Anbo was dispatched in pursuit.

literal: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then returned, and over a thousand households of the remnant force were walled at Tong Prefecture.
idiomatic: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then withdrew, and more than a thousand households of the remnant force were settled behind walls at Tong Prefecture.

literal: That autumn, returned from Pinbi Marsh.
idiomatic: That autumn he returned from Pinbi Marsh.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, ice-fished on the Tu River.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he ice-fished on the Tu River.

literal: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first month of spring, Song sent envoys on a visit.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first spring month, Song sent envoys on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the second month, on renyin day, instructed Hanlin academicians that in writing the empress's words also use "I" (zhen and yu), establishing this as fixed form.
idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month he instructed the Hanlin academicians that in official records the empress's pronouncements were also to use "I" — both zhen and yu — and this was established as fixed convention.

literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the four directions after widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and those impoverished who had lost office, and relieved them.
idiomatic: On xinwei day in the third month he dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the realm after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, as well as the poor who had lost their positions, and granted them relief.

literal: In the sixth month of summer, Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was made Northern Court Great King.
idiomatic: In the sixth summer month Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was appointed Northern Court Great King.

literal: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, bingyin day, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed; Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were struck from the rolls.
idiomatic: On bingyin day, the first of the seventh autumn month, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed and Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were removed from office.

literal: On xinwei day, Song sent envoys to congratulate the Tianqing Festival.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Song sent envoys to offer congratulations on the Tianqing Festival.

literal: In the eighth month, on guimao day, Han sent envoys saying that for the Tianqing Festival they held an unbounded assembly, fed monks, and prayed for blessings.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the eighth month Han sent envoys reporting that for the Tianqing Festival they had held an unbounded assembly, fed the monks, and prayed for blessings.

literal: On dingwei day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On dingwei day he went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: On jiyou day, Han came reporting Song affairs.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Han sent word reporting developments in Song affairs.

literal: That month, Jurchen invaded the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.
idiomatic: That month Jurchen raided the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.

literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, visited Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jisi day in the ninth month he visited Huai Mausoleum.

literal: On xinwei day, Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported Jurchen attacked five stockades of Gui Prefecture and raided away.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported that Jurchen had struck five stockades in Gui Prefecture and withdrawn after plundering.

literal: On yihai day, Biegude came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yihai day the Biegude brought tribute.

literal: On renwu day, Han being invaded by Song sent envoys seeking aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to go.
idiomatic: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to march to their relief.

literal: On wuzi day, Han reported Song army pressing the border; imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun was sent to inform.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Han reported that Song troops were pressing the frontier and sent imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun to notify the court.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, Han came to thank because Liao army drove back Song army.
idiomatic: On xinchou day in the tenth winter month Han sent envoys to thank the court after Liao troops had driven back the Song army.

literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi seized the throne and sent envoys to announce.
idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eleventh month Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi took the throne himself and sent envoys to announce the fact.

literal: On xinmao day, dispatched langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others as envoys to Song for condolences.
idiomatic: On xinmao day langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others were dispatched to Song to offer mourning condolences.

literal: In the twelfth month, on renyin day, dispatched Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe to congratulate Song on accession.
idiomatic: On renyin day in the twelfth month Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe were sent to congratulate Song on the new ruler's accession.

literal: On dingwei day, Han reported Song army again arrived and plundered their military stores.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Han reported that Song troops had again crossed the border and stripped their military stores.

literal: And requested grain as aid.
idiomatic: They also begged grain as assistance.

literal: On wuwu day, edict restored Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered the restoration of the Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.

literal: That month, Kirghiz sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That month envoys from Kirghiz arrived with tribute.
